issue_text: A corrupt pool file passes the inputs gate as an empty index

A.fix: Name every unreadable pool file in the inputs gate and hold (the INTAKE-1 card's own next step): _load's failure becomes a gate finding, not a shrug.

B.fix: components/intake/tools/pools.py: have _load record each unreadable path in a module list (or raise), and have found() report it; components/intake/tools/gates.py inputs_problems(): add one problem line per unreadable pool file so the always-hold inputs gate stops the run; add a test with a truncated blocks.json.
